name: qtim
description: Codex-native bootstrap and orchestration kit for project-specific subagent teams. Role-aware setup for developers and PM/analysts. Includes setup, feature pipeline (idea to PRD, decomposition, estimate, plan), team-up, team-lazy, team-down, team-retro, onboard, product-onboard, doctor and update skills, versioned generated state, custom agent templates, intake rules, orchestration patterns and recipes, independent review gates, epic-state session handoff, and lifecycle hooks.

interface.longDescription: qtim adapts a project into a Codex-native team workflow for two roles. Developers get a full subagent team with implement/test/review loops; PM/analysts get a feature pipeline that turns a raw idea into a PRD, grounded decomposition, relative estimates, and an implementation plan documented in docs/features/. Setup asks for the role and generates .codex/team-charter.md with track blocks, custom .codex/agents/*.toml roles, project memory, hooks, and reusable skills. Generated state is version-stamped, and the update skill migrates a project team to the current plugin version.
defaultPrompt: Set up qtim for this project
Run the qtim feature pipeline for this idea
Run qtim team-up for this epic
